Release build fails with E0463 can't find crate for a proc macro (tauri_macros, derive_more_impl, phf_macros) on macOS 27
error: Release build fails with E0463 can't find crate for a proc macro (tauri_macros, derive_more_impl, phf_macros) on macOS 27
fix: Makefile release builds link with rustc's bundled lld (-fuse-ld=lld -B gcc-ld) against the macOS 26 SDK (lld can't parse the 27 SDK's arm64e.x1 .tbd files), and scope the home-path remap with --remap-path-scope=object
root_cause: macOS 27's Apple linker (ld-27037) sometimes writes a dylib whose LINKEDIT string pool dyld rejects as mis-aligned, so rustc can't dlopen the proc macro it just built; which dylibs are hit depends on symbol-name lengths, so it moved with RUSTFLAGS and features
